On the 11th, in the remembrance of Huzoor Ghaus-e-Azam Shaikh Abdul Qadir Jilani (Rahmatullahi Alaih): a seeker by the river at night calls out, lamps light the path, and every flame bows toward the light. (He is never drawn, only shown as light.)
